in_marathi.name: Kshanvik
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Instants of time
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kshanvik हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Kshanvik is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Kshan' meaning instant and 'Vik' meaning power. This name signifies one who possesses the power to control moments in time.
